description: 后对王-L1 解法4：困毙陷阱警示

intro.popup_en: Solution 4: A stalemate trap. White has a winning position but can draw with one mistake. Watch White's fifth move: is Kc7 correct?
intro.popup:
⚠️ 解法4：困毙陷阱！
这一局演示了一个严重错误！白方本来必胜，却因为一步失误造成和棋（困毙）。
仔细看白方第5步——Kc7 对吗？

outro.popup_en: Kc7 is stalemate and a draw! The black king on a6 is not in check but has no legal move. A winning endgame has become a draw, one of the most common queen-endgame mistakes.
outro.popup:
⚠️ Kc7 — 困毙！和棋！
黑王在a6没有被将军，但也没有任何合法走步——这就是「困毙」！
必赢的残局瞬间变成和棋。后残局中这是最常见的失误！

moves.popup_en: ...Ka5 moves the black king down, away from the corner.
moves.popup: ⬇️ Ka5 — 黑王向下走，避开角落方向。

moves.popup_en: 2.Ke7 begins bringing the white king closer.
...Kb6 moves the black king toward the center.

moves.popup: ⬇️ Kb7 — 黑王往角落方向撤退。

moves.popup_en: 4.Qc5! The queen controls key squares on the a-file and the diagonal toward a7, reducing the black king's mobility.
moves.popup:
⬆️ 4.Qc5 — 后控制关键格。
Qc5控制a5、b6/a7对角线，黑王活动空间越来越小。

moves.popup_en: ...Ka6 is the black king's only move. Be careful: the king is not in check, but could have no legal moves after White's next move.
moves.popup:
⬇️ Ka6 — 黑王只能在a6。
⚠️ 现在注意！黑王在a6，没有被将军，但下一步可能无处可走！
请仔细看白方下一步……

moves.popup_en: 5.Kc7?? Stalemate! The black king on a6 is not in check, but every escape square is controlled: Qc5 covers a5 and a7, while the white king and queen cover b5, b6, and b7. No check and no legal move means a draw. White has thrown away a winning position.
moves.popup:
🔴 5.Kc7 — 和棋！困毙！
黑王在a6：a5被Qc5封锁，a7被Qc5对角线封锁，b5/b6/b7被王和后共同封锁。
黑王没有被将军，却无路可走 = 困毙 = 和棋！
必赢的残局瞬间变成平局 —— 这是后残局最常见也最危险的失误！
